## Activity

During June 2025, East City Eye Clinic recorded 199 captures. This figure represents the activity completed by the clinic during the reporting month. The site’s capture activity is reported here for operational monitoring and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

Of the 199 captures, 6 were marked ungradable by graders. The ungradable rate was 3.0 per cent of captures. This measure indicates the proportion of images that could not be used for grading and is reported alongside total capture activity to support review of image quality at the site.

## Grading

Grading identified 62 referable results during June 2025. The median lag between photograph capture and completion of grading was 3 days. This provides the site-level measure of timeliness for the reporting period and should be considered with the total capture volume and image quality results.

No new equipment faults were raised at East City Eye Clinic during June 2025.
